title: Startup sues Apple in India over tap-to-share contacts feature | TechCrunch
summary: Apple is being sued in India by a U.S.-based startup that alleges the iPhone maker’s NameDrop feature, which lets users share contact information by bringing devices close together, infringes its patented technology.
